def factor_volume_return_dir_corr_zvol_clipped(df):
    """Rolling correlation between daily return and clipped z-scored volume deviation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_std = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).std(ddof=1)
    vol_dev = (df_copy["volume"] - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_dev_clipped = vol_dev.clip(lower=-3.0, upper=3.0)
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_dev_clipped)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_zvol_clipped"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_zvol_clipped"]
